title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: flux.cpp and residual.cpp implement 2-D compressible inviscid and viscous flux paths; seven selected cases fail.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:158–176 uses /Base HDF5 layout, discovers zones and handles supported separate element sections; general CGNS names/types are limited.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: residual.cpp uses face fluxes and boundary paths; selected case failures and partition-boundary ghost reconstruction limit confidence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp:39–42,76 implements Roe with Rusanov fallback; failed cases limit production credibility.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: residual.cpp handles wall/farfield fluxes; output.cpp:69–72 writes zero no-slip wall velocities.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: grad.cpp:9–14 computes owned-cell least-squares gradients; residual.cpp:16–21 uses unreconstructed ghost state at partition boundaries.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: grad.cpp:81–125 applies Barth-style limiting and positivity checks on owned reconstructed states; ghost side remains first order.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: forces.cpp:24–37 projects tangential shear, and residual.cpp:57–67 evaluates wall viscous stress. All selected laminar/cylinder results are failed.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: driver.cpp implements iterative steady solve and rollback, but six selected steady cases fail and one converges; individual histories documented.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:1094–1112 freezes BDF anchor and records actual outcomes; selected Re200 is failed at t30 with 3000 target misses and max3142 reported inner evaluations.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only setup, METIS and neighbor halos are implemented. Re20 np1/np2 Cd differs by2.0667 at step300 with identical case JSON and same logged initialization; runs fail and bracket a source fix with unknown binary revisions, so DQ4 rank-only causation is unproven.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
